detention_type_code.name: detention_type_code
detention_type_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier representing a specific type of detention period.

detention_type_description.name: detention_type_description
detention_type_description.meaning: A human-readable text description explaining the nature or timing of the detention type.

table.name: d_academic__domain_publication
table.summary: A relationship table linking domain entities to publication entities.

did.name: did
did.meaning: Unique identifier for a domain entity.

pid.name: pid
pid.meaning: Unique identifier for a publication entity.

table.name: d_course_teach__teacher
table.summary: A table containing demographic and personal information for teachers, including their ID, name, age, and hometown.

teacher_id.name: teacher_id
teacher_id.meaning: A unique identifier for each teacher record.

name.name: name
name.meaning: The full name of the teacher.

age.name: age
age.meaning: The current age of the teacher in years.

hometown.name: hometown
hometown.meaning: The town or district where the teacher is from.

table.name: d_company_1__employee
table.summary: Stores detailed personal and employment information for employees, including demographics, contact details, compensation, and departmental assignment.

minit.name: minit
minit.meaning: Initial of the employee's middle name.

ssn.name: ssn
ssn.meaning: Social Security Number, a unique identifier for the employee.

bdate.name: bdate
bdate.meaning: Date of birth of the employee.

address.name: address
address.meaning: Physical residential address of the employee.

salary.name: salary
salary.meaning: Annual compensation amount for the employee.

super_ssn.name: super_ssn
super_ssn.meaning: Social Security Number of the employee's direct supervisor.

dno.name: dno
dno.meaning: Department number where the employee works.

table.name: d_e_government__organizations
table.summary: A table containing core details about political organizations, including their unique identifier, formation date, name, and VAT registration number.

organization_id.name: organization_id
organization_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each organization record.

date_formed.name: date_formed
date_formed.meaning: The date on which the organization was officially established.

organization_name.name: organization_name
organization_name.meaning: The official name of the political organization.

uk_vat_number.name: uk_vat_number
uk_vat_number.meaning: The UK Value Added Tax registration number assigned to the organization.

table.name: d_musical__actor
table.summary: A table containing information about actors, including their names, associated musicals, characters played, tenure duration, and age.

actor_id.name: actor_id
actor_id.meaning: A unique identifier for each actor record in the table.

name.name: name
name.meaning: The full name of the actor.

musical_id.name: musical_id
musical_id.meaning: A foreign key linking the actor to a specific musical production.

character.name: character
character.meaning: The name of the character played by the actor in the associated musical.

duration.name: duration
duration.meaning: The time period during which the actor played the character, often indicating start and end years.

age.name: age
age.meaning: The age of the actor at the time of the record or during their tenure.

table.name: d_cre_Theme_park__features
table.summary: A lookup table defining a set of named features with unique integer identifiers.

feature_id.name: feature_id
feature_id.meaning: A unique integer identifier assigned to each feature record.

feature_details.name: feature_details
feature_details.meaning: A short textual description or name representing the type or category of the feature.

table.name: d_voter_2__voting_record
table.summary: Records of student voting participation in various school elections, including dates, election cycles, and votes cast for specific office holders.

stuid.name: stuid
stuid.meaning: Unique identifier for the student who cast the vote.

registration_date.name: registration_date
registration_date.meaning: The date on which the student registered to vote in the election.

election_cycle.name: election_cycle
election_cycle.meaning: The specific term or cycle of the election (e.g., Spring, Fall).

president_vote.name: president_vote
president_vote.meaning: The ID or code of the candidate selected for the position of President.

vice_president_vote.name: vice_president_vote
vice_president_vote.meaning: The ID or code of the candidate selected for the position of Vice President.

secretary_vote.name: secretary_vote
secretary_vote.meaning: The ID or code of the candidate selected for the position of Secretary.

treasurer_vote.name: treasurer_vote
treasurer_vote.meaning: The ID or code of the candidate selected for the position of Treasurer.

class_president_vote.name: class_president_vote
class_president_vote.meaning: The ID or code of the candidate selected for the position of Class President.

class_senator_vote.name: class_senator_vote
class_senator_vote.meaning: The ID or code of the candidate selected for the position of Class Senator.

table.name: d_department_store__supplier_addresses
table.summary: A table recording the historical validity periods of addresses associated with specific suppliers.

supplier_id.name: supplier_id
supplier_id.meaning: Unique identifier linking the address record to a specific supplier entity.

address_id.name: address_id
address_id.meaning: Unique identifier for the specific address record within the system.

date_from.name: date_from
date_from.meaning: The start date and time when this address became valid for the supplier.

date_to.name: date_to
date_to.meaning: The end date and time when this address ceased to be valid (nullable, indicating current records).
